title: NSTAR Gas Company files for review and approval of a Firm Transportation Agreement with the University of Massachusetts.
filings: The Department APPROVES the proposed Agreement. The Department finds also, that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul G. Afonso, Chariman; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Eugene J. Sullivan and Deirdre K. Manning. (DTE 04-GC-15)
NSTAR Gas Company's unredacted responses to the Department's First Set of Information Requests. By David S. Rosenzweig. DTE 04-GC-15
